How it works

The differentiator

The avatar is the easy part.

Anyone can generate a talking head. That stopped being hard a while ago, and every tool on the market does it.

The hard part is everything around it. Knowing what moved in your industry overnight. Turning what you actually think into a script that sounds like you wrote it. Cutting it, captioning it, putting it live in the right place.

We built that whole chain into one system. No tools, no logins, no files moving between people, and nothing that needs your attention on a Tuesday morning.
